comment: Dr. Nuray is a very sweet lady but a very unorganized professor. I took a research class with her and I don't think I'd be able to do well unless I had prior experience in writing papers. She easily digresses in class, takes months to read papers and is not available for office hours. However, it is fairly easy if you have background in writing.
Superb!
Awesome Professor.. Love her.

Dr. Grove is a very flighty teacher: she is prone to lateness and nearly always willing to extend deadlines or adjust the syllabus, which is admittedly great for students adapting to a college workload.  Even so, she knows what she's talking about more or less and tends to be able to separate BS papers from legit ones.

what an idiot. plays major favorites. she never showed up the first semester and was constantly late. shes also a ridiculously random grader. never know what you'll get if you put effort or not. people never came the second half of the semester and they have As.
Super hot teacher
Never went to class, hardly paid attention. Failed to turn in last two papers, and still came out with an A+.

Dr. Grove is not that bad. If you give effort in your class, you can actually get something out of it. CORE actually made me think a lot this year, and I'm really glad I had Dr. Grove as a teacher. She is creative in her assignments, and I think that sometimes students mistake it for carelessness. It would be nice if she was more punctual...

Possibly the worst CORE teacher ever.  She plays favorites, never grades the work (papers, midterms, etc) you turn in, just assigns grades on how much she likes you, and dosen't notice when students stop going to class  for the rest of the semester.  The only good part is that you don't actually have to do the reading.
Basically, everything that everyone else who had her for core said already is true.  I feel sorry for you if you get her for CORE.

oh my goodness!!! never ever try to think of getting into her class. she sucks believe me..... she is the most awful teacher i have seen in whole my life. she does not know and she currently got her PHD too... i do not which fool gave her the PHD degree. she even does not deserve a Bachelor.

Really incompetent teacher. Wonder who hired her because of her I almost missed a paper deadline. Incredibly unprofessional and disorganized. Not only she did not help me with my Freudian paper, but showed she does not know the meaning of "incoherent" when actually 2 paragraphs are well connected. How did she get her degree?

Awful class. Period. Doesnt teach us, we teach her. Expects us to draw the same conclusions as her on every piece of reading. No interesting points to offer. Never responds to emails. Nice lady, but not an ideal teacher. Has some vendetta against students when it comes to grading.

biggest **** ever. popup quizzes all the time. surprise essays. very hard grader. AVOID AT ANY TIME
